name: Mailchimp
description: An email & SMS marketing platform combining marketing analytics, automations, and AI tools to help businesses drive revenue through integrated customer communications.
best_for: Positioned for small to mid-sized businesses (retail/e-commerce, hospitality, nonprofits, professional services, content creators) who want an easy-to-use email/SMS marketing tool without needing extensive marketing experience.
features: Drag-and-drop email builder with 300+ templates and AI content generation
Always-on marketing automations (welcome sequences, customer journeys)
Analytics dashboards for opens, clicks, and engagement
300+ native integrations (Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Salesforce, Zapier)

alternatives.name: ActiveCampaign
alternatives.description: An autonomous marketing platform where AI agents handle email, SMS, WhatsApp, and CRM tasks backed by customer data.
alternatives.best_for: Growing businesses that want to automate marketing and sales work and reduce manual effort.

alternatives.name: Klaviyo
alternatives.description: An AI marketing and service platform built as an autonomous B2C CRM unifying customer data with omnichannel automation.
alternatives.best_for: Consumer/B2C brands, especially e-commerce retailers, wanting unified customer data and marketing.
